content.title: Saba Capital Management, L.P. Increases Stake in Adams Natural Resources Fund Inc
content.summary: On September 26, 2024, Saba Capital Management, L.P. (Trades, Portfolio), a prominent investment firm, expanded its portfolio by acquiring an additional 16,514 shares of Adams Natural Resources Fund Inc (NYSE:PEO).  This transaction increased the firm's total holdings in PEO to 2,888,924 shares, marking a significant enhancement of its investment in the energy and natural resources sector.  The shares were purchased at a price of $22.85 each, reflecting a strategic addition to Saba Capital's diverse investment portfolio.
